Kylix.name: 欢宴魔 Kylix
Kylix.publicNotes:
这些外表优雅、形似凡人的欢宴魔，或称为斟酒魔鬼，极少掩盖其自身的地狱本质，不过他却更偏爱以高雅精致的服装凸显其形体的美感与对称。他们仿佛是闲言碎语与机智攀谈相结合的舞蹈，在微笑的调情暗示间许下半真半假的友谊。无论他去往何处，总是能迅速与人交好，单是其存在似乎就能平息叛乱与冲突。斟酒魔鬼是占领的“脸面”；凭借魔性的魅力，他能剥夺参与叛乱的革命者，使伴侣分隔开来，窃走襁褓中的孩童，并在完成这一切的同时得到受害者的感谢。

斟酒魔鬼塑造着艺术与文化，运用其在欢宴与行乐上的天赋，诱使宾客及随从堕入他邪恶的魅力之中。斟酒魔鬼倡导地狱乃是文明的壁垒；他凭借着闪烁的器皿与不经意却诚恳的奉承，提醒对方地狱才是最佳的归宿，人们无需畏惧其法则。
Kylix.allSaves: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1点状态

False Friend.name: 虚假朋友 False Friend
False Friend.description: 欢宴魔的非伤害法术获得晦匿特征。

Raise a Glass.name: 举杯致意 Raise a Glass
Raise a Glass.description: 当欢宴魔正手持一杯饮料，并且没有持用武器或穿戴护甲时，他会持续受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8xRzLhwGL7Dgy3EZ]（@Check[will|dc:21]）的保护。若欢宴魔打破了圣域术，那么魔鬼必须停止采取任何敌对动作达10分钟之后，该效果才会恢复。此外，当欢宴魔受到圣域术保护时，他能投掷交涉技能来决定先攻。

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Courteous Causerie.name: 礼貌漫谈 Courteous Causerie
Courteous Causerie.description: 欢宴魔尝试@Check[deception]、@Check[diplomacy]、@Check[performance]或@Check[society]检定，并将其结果与60尺射程内的至多四个生物的意志DC进行比较。成功时，这些生物会陷入持续1轮的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。欢宴魔能维持该效果，增加该迷魂的持续时间1轮，至多增加至1分钟。当该迷魂结束时，受影响的生物都会临时免疫礼貌漫谈，持续1小时。

Hand in Glove.name: 密切配合 Hand in Glove
Hand in Glove.description: 若敌人同时位于自身以及一个盟友的触及之内，欢宴魔就能夹击该敌人；欢宴魔与其盟友不需要分别站在敌人的对侧。欢宴魔的盟友也能从该效果中获益，但仅限与欢宴魔夹击敌人时有效，不适用于其他盟友间的夹击判定。夹击的其他需求条件仍需要得到满足。

Sparkling Wit.name: 妙语连珠 Sparkling Wit
Sparkling Wit.description: 若生物陷入了对欢宴魔的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]，那么该生物对欢宴魔来说还处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。

Velavi.name: 藏典魔 Velavi
Velavi.publicNotes:
知识即是力量，没有人能比藏典魔更为敏锐地意识到这条真理。这些抄书员以及次级学者奉命掌管着泰吉亚（Stygia）的谎言学院（Academies of Lies）中深不可测的浩瀚馆藏。藏典魔是图书馆的门面，负责接待访客并决定是否批准其请求。其组织能力在地狱中堪称翘楚，并且她善于长期记忆，因此能在宛如其家园的图书馆内以令人惊异的速度穿梭。藏典魔还为地狱提供着另一项至关重要的服务：若有其他魔鬼作出了具有价值的发现，他们应当向学院报告，然后由藏典魔记录在卷轴或者由藏典魔亲手用活体血肉制作的书籍中。

每名藏典魔都非常熟悉她们所在的图书馆的藏书，她们能不受限制地访问其他学院的档案。那些在地狱中寻求信息的人可能会试图寻求藏典魔的帮助，但是藏典魔在让渡任何信息之前都会提出极其高昂的代价——即便如此，知识也几乎总是单向流往藏典魔，因为她们在分享信息时总会设下诸般诡计。司书魔鬼是保管人、守门人与守护者；藏典魔极少会与高阶魔鬼之外的存在分享知识，但即便对方是高阶魔鬼，也必须对其使用威逼利诱等手段。
Velavi.allSaves: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Frightening Shush.name: 骇人噤声 Frightening Shush
Frightening Shush.description:
藏典魔发出威胁，作出让人噤声的动作。30尺内的生物必须尝试@Check[will|dc:18]豁免。藏典魔在[[/br 1d4 #Recharge Frightening Shush]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用骇人噤声。

大成功 该生物不会受到额外影响。

成功 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}。只要该生物还处于此能力造成的惊惧状态，对藏典魔来说就还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。

大失败 同失败，而且该生物在惊惧期间还无法发出任何声音，就如同受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]的法术影响一般。

Novice Hellknight Armiger.name: 见习地狱骑士扈从 Novice Hellknight Armiger

Goblin Scuttle.name: 地精快步 Goblin Scuttle
Goblin Scuttle.description:
触发 一名地精盟友在与布拉克纳普相邻的位置结束一个移动动作

效果 布拉克纳普快步。

Evoke Fault.name: 揭示弱点 Evoke Fault
Evoke Fault.description: 布拉克纳普的先祖精魂告知他30尺内一名敌人的弱点。直到他的回合结束，布拉克纳普下一次针对该目标的打击，其攻击检定获得+1状态加值，且该打击造成额外1d6点精准伤害。在他的回合结束时，布拉克纳普陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1}，持续1分钟。若布拉克纳普在处于笨拙状态时使用揭示弱点，其笨拙状态数值增加1，最高为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 3}。

Vision of Goblins' Fall.name: 地精陨落幻景 Vision of Goblins' Fall
Vision of Goblins' Fall.description:
频率 每10分钟1次

效果 布拉克纳普触碰一名敌人，使其体验尖叫森林的地精在地精血战期间遭受的痛苦。目标承受@Damage[3d6[mental]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:21|basic]豁免）。豁免失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}）。

Insidiator.name: 构陷魔 Insidiator
Insidiator.publicNotes:
这些魔鬼来自九层地狱的第一层，负责诱捕那些容易被诱惑的人、以及编织导致凡人灵魂堕落的阴谋来为上级服务。构陷魔常被招募来设置钓鱼行动，诱使凡人犯下可怖的罪行，或者去揭露其他魔族对手的诡计。他们乐于目睹猎物落入其精心设计的圈套，并且可能会为了制定完美的计划而耗费数年——尽管效率最高的人才更有可能在地狱的阶级中攀升。

构陷魔的狡诈天赋延伸到了自身的物质形体上。其蝙蝠一般的翅膀看似宛如薄纱一般，却犹如它所模仿的蜘蛛网一般，十分适合用于捕获猎物，能够黏住敌人并把它困于肉搏战中。当情绪变化或者情势所迫时，诱捕魔鬼还可以改变皮肤与翅膀的颜色以避免侦测。

构陷魔通常会避免正面战斗，更偏好以诡计和心理操纵的游戏中戏耍目标。他的特长在于擅长将目标引导上一条曲折的道路，最终令其陷入自我诅咒或自证其罪的末路，迫使对方同意构陷魔的要求。若有潜在的受害者看穿了构陷魔的诡计，他便会承认暂时的失败，在离去后重新编织诡计。当所有诡计都已经失败，必须诉诸武力之时，诱捕魔鬼亦能成为合格的战士，他会利用蛛网般的翅膀和伪装能力抢占先机，运用伏击战术令对手猝不及防。
Insidiator.allSaves: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Chameleon Skin.name: 变色外皮 Chameleon Skin
Chameleon Skin.description: 构陷魔改变皮肤的颜色以适应周遭的环境。这么做甚至可以让他们在缺乏掩蔽的情况下躲藏。当构陷魔移动到不同的环境中时，他必须再次使用该能力，否则将会失去该能力带来的效果。

Change Shape.name: 变身 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
构陷魔能呈现出任意中型类人生物的外观。这不会改变他的速度或其打击的攻击与伤害的加值，但是可能会改变其打击造成的伤害类型（通常为钝击）。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Hidden Movement.name: 隐秘行动 Hidden Movement
Hidden Movement.description: 若构陷魔在开始回合时对某个生物处于无踪或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]状态，该生物在对抗构陷魔的攻击时会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]，直至构陷魔的回合结束为止。

Web Trap.name: 蛛网陷阱 Web Trap
Web Trap.description: 被构陷魔的蛛网打击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]，并被黏在最近的表面上，直至它[[/act escape dc=17]]为止。

Nayren Allurajix.name: 奈伦·阿鲁拉吉克 Nayren Allurajix
Nayren Allurajix.allSaves: （对抗区域效果时反射豁免为+19）

+3 Status to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effec.name: 对抗区域效果时反射豁免获得+3点状态加值 +3 Status to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effects

Disillusionment.name: 幻觉破灭 Disillusionment
Disillusionment.description: 每当奈伦成功通过对抗幻术效果的豁免时，她改为获得大成功。

Return to Battle.name: 重返战斗 Return to Battle
Return to Battle.description:
触发 奈伦的生命值降至0或更低

效果 异界裔血脉中的战意仍在奔涌。奈伦自动稳定伤势并获得1点生命值。她站立起身。该移动不会触发反应动作。

Rack the Dissidents.name: 鞭笞异见者 Rack the Dissidents
Rack the Dissidents.description:
频率 每日1次

效果 奈伦的打击使她保持精力充沛，得以继续击倒叛军。持续1分钟或直到她的打击大失败为止；在此期间，每轮第一次，当奈伦成功打击一个生物时，她获得5点临时生命值，持续1轮。

Silence, Heretic!.name: 住口，异端！ Silence, Heretic!
Silence, Heretic!.description: 奈伦进行一次长剑打击。若该攻击命中，目标必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:29]豁免，否则在1轮内无法使用听觉动作。此效果也会阻止目标施放法术，除非是晦匿法术，或是不需要在施放时使用魔法咒语的法术。若大失败，则持续时间改为1分钟。无论豁免结果如何，目标都会在10分钟内对此能力临时免疫。

Caeto Vulaunex.name: 凯托·乌劳内克斯 Caeto Vulaunex

+2 Status to Will Saves vs. Mental.name: +2 Status to Will Saves vs. Mental

Godclaw Aura.name: Godclaw Aura
Godclaw Aura.description: 15 feet. Followers of any deities on the Godclaw pantheon or of the pantheon itself within the aura immediately know Caeto is a champion of the Godclaw.

Steel Command.name: Steel Command
Steel Command.description:
Trigger A creature in Caeto's aura damages him

Effect Caeto commands his enemy to kneel in supplication. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] save. They then become immune to Steel Command for 1 minute.

Success The creature must choose to drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} as a free action or take @Damage[3d6[mental],1d8[persistent,spirit]] damage.

Failure The creature must choose to drop prone as a free action and be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} or take @Damage[6d6[mental],2d8[persistent,spirit]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature drops prone, is slowed 1, and takes @Damage[12d6[mental],2d8[persistent,spirit]] damage

Hand of the Avenger.name: Hand of the Avenger
Hand of the Avenger.description: Caeto evokes his oath to bring justice to those he deems a threat to Isger. Until the end of his turn, Caeto can use his lay on hands to damage an enemy in his aura as if they were undead, dealing spirit damage instead of vitality damage.

Lawbreaker's Bane.name: Lawbreaker's Bane
Lawbreaker's Bane.description: Caeto gains a +4 status bonus on damage to Strikes against targets that he knows have broken the law. The bonus increases to +6 if the target is a known member of the Hellbreakers League.

Oppressive Might.name: Oppressive Might
Oppressive Might.description: Caeto uses his posture to assert dominance over the masses. He attempts an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] all non-allied creatures within 60 feet. He doesn't take a penalty against targets who don't understand his language. On a critical success, that target doesn't become temporarily immune to Caeto's other attempts to Demoralize them.

Subdue Fugitive.name: Subdue Fugitive
Subdue Fugitive.description:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements Caeto is wielding his longsword

Effect Caeto uses his shifting rune's Shift Weapon to transform his sword into a flail and makes a melee Strike with it. If the Strike hits and deals damage, he can attempt an Athletics check as a free action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target of the Strike. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward Caeto's multiple attack penalty.

Pacify Fey.name: Pacify Fey
Pacify Fey.description: 40 feet. All creatures with the fey trait who enter or begin their turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature becomes immune to the aura for 1 day. On a failure, the creature can't take hostile actions against the katroome.

Enveloping Web.name: Enveloping Web
Enveloping Web.description: The web of the empress katroome wraps creatures into a cocoon. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} while it's enveloped in a cocoon ([[/act escape dc=26]]). The web has Hardness 10 and 20 Hit Points. It has resistance 5 to bludgeoning and piercing and weakness 5 to slashing. At the end of the target's turn, if it has yet to Escape from enveloping web, the web grows, increasing the slowed value by 1, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 3}. The katroome can envelop up to three creatures at a time.

Glittering Scales.name: Glittering Scales
Glittering Scales.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The katroome flaps its wings of prismatic scales. All creatures within a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] takes @Damage[9d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save. On a failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} on a critical failure.

Adjutant Hellknight Armiger.name: 副官地狱骑士扈从 Adjutant Hellknight Armiger

Pinning Strike.name: 钉刺打击 Pinning Strike
Pinning Strike.description: 副官地狱骑士扈从进行一次戟打击。成功时，目标还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]，持续至副官地狱骑士扈从的下一回合开始或副官地狱骑士扈从移动至与目标的距离超过10尺处或副官地狱骑士扈从再进行一次戟打击为止，以先到者为准。目标也可以尝试[[/act escape dc=18]] 。

Gliding River Snake.name: 掠河蛇 Gliding River Snake
Gliding River Snake.publicNotes:
精明的旅人往往会提防道路一旁的蛇，但很少有人会料到它们能从天而降。在遇到危险时，掠河蛇会爬上高处，然后再向着目标扑去，它能通过将肋骨压扁来在空中滑翔，并且能够通过扭转身体来控制飞行方向。若无法从空中发动袭击，掠河蛇便会尝试直接咬向目标，折断对方的一两根手指。这种蛇的下颚力量极强，能利落地咬穿骨肉。

毒性温和的掠河蛇更喜欢独处，但对潜在威胁反应强烈，会凶猛地扑上去啃咬。其口中布满锯齿状的尖牙，能够撕裂猎物，而非像普通的蛇类那般只能刺穿对方。凭借这些尖牙，掠河蛇能在吞咽之前将食物撕扯成小块，使其能够狩猎体型更大的目标。有时会有不幸的动物遭到多条掠河蛇的围攻，身上会被翻腾的蛇身所覆盖。这种集体进食的场景过去曾被误认为一种独立的怪物，因为在这些蛇进餐之际，外界也只能看到外侧那触手状的躯体。

掠河蛇通常会成对生活，在交配季节与其伴侣共处，过了这段时期便会分开。它们会将蛇蛋产在树上或水下，有时甚至会在吞食鸟蛋之后将鸟巢据为己有。许多观鸟者都会因为看到树梢上破壳而出的蛇而大吃一惊，偶尔会有蛇蛋与鸟蛋被放在一起，以便幼蛇在孵化之后能够轻易获得食物。

Aerial Ambush.name: 空中伏击 Aerial Ambush
Aerial Ambush.description:
需求 掠河蛇所处的位置比目标生物高

效果 掠河蛇向着下方至多20尺远的生物窜出，并对其作出一次下颚打击。若蛇命中了，它就不会由于坠落而承受伤害。若未命中，它从坠落距离中承受的伤害仅相当于常规伤害的一半。

Aquatic Ambush.name: 水下伏击 Aquatic Ambush
Aquatic Ambush.description:
需求 掠河蛇在水中，且20尺内有未能侦测到蛇的生物

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

阶段1 @Damage[1d8[poison]]伤害（1轮）

Weaving Glide.name: 迂回滑翔 Weaving Glide
Weaving Glide.description: 掠河蛇向地面滑翔，在空中下降5尺高度并向前移动20尺。只要它每轮至少花费1个动作滑翔，并且还未到达地面，它在自身回合结束时就能留在空中。

Stumpfield War Saboteurs.name: 树桩地战争破坏者 Stumpfield War Saboteurs
Stumpfield War Saboteurs.publicNotes: 树桩地的艺术家们享受着创作的混沌，这让他们同样非常适应与之相对的毁灭的混沌。破坏难道不正是一种艺术的形式么？树桩地无疑如此认为，其居民也乐于使用他们的创意技能来拦截敌人和伏击部队。

Duck, Duck, Loose!.name: 躲，闪，分散！ Duck, Duck, Loose!
Duck, Duck, Loose!.description:
触发 破坏者成为打击的目标，或者成为需要反射豁免的效果目标

效果 破坏者慌乱地寻找着最近的掩蔽。他们获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}，但也会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]，持续至他们的下个回合开始为止。

Rush and Steal.name: 冲上去偷 Rush and Steal
Rush and Steal.description: 树桩地战争破坏者眼疾手快地冲上去，能拿什么就拿什么。破坏者至多以其速度的两倍行走。在这次移动中，破坏者能以交互捡起不超过2负载的1件无主物品，或者尝试对相邻的1个生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]1件物品；地精们能以任意组合方式捡起或盗窃数量等同于部队剩余部分数值的物品。

Slapstick Traps.name: 恶作剧陷阱 Slapstick Traps
Slapstick Traps.description:
需求 破坏者的上个动作是成功的躲藏

效果 破坏者趁着别人看不到的时候设置了会坠落的障碍物。破坏者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]2次。直至破坏者的下个回合开始为止，任意非盟友生物移动进入到破坏者曾经潜行经过的方格时，会承受@Damage[5d8[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]豁免）。大失败时，该生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。当该陷阱被触发后，破坏者曾经潜行经过的剩余方格会变为困难地形，持续至有生物花费1小时将其清理为止。

频率 1次/轮

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.izuJvgHjqI6kQNbK]{Effect: Denounce}

Hell's Glare.name: Hell's Glare
Hell's Glare.description: Lamperia's eyes glow like the fires of Hell as she swings her blade. Lamperia makes a rapier Strike. If she hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit).

Coarti Spy.name: Coarti Spy
Coarti Spy.publicNotes:
The burning-winged coartis are marked by the onerous contracts they agreed to and bound to Hell by the machinations of a legalistic devil, usually a phistophilus. Some coartis are truly a type of fallen celestial, those trapped in horrible agreements for the greater good or due to grievous errors in judgment, but most arise from mortal souls that were on the path to become celestials yet were contractually bound to Hell. Coartis serve in public roles as messengers and personal attendants to demonstrate the power of Hell and the legal acumen of their corruptors.

Celestials universally pity coartis and despise their creators, but their preferred methods of dealing with the corrupted beings differ. While angels argue against lost cases in Pharasma's courts, seeking loopholes in the voluminous contracts, azatas scheme daring heists against the contract storehouses. Archons are the most direct, working to end their blighted lives.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks.

Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly orts perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as infantry and contract devils, while the greatest nessaris command entire infernal armies.

Asmodeus stands at the apex of the structure he created, but the layers below him are marked by a constant jockeying for position. Most diabolic plans ultimately serve to improve the schemer's place in the hierarchy.

Warshard Wight.name: Warshard Wight
Warshard Wight.publicNotes:
Wights are intelligent undead spawned through inescapable cycles of spite. This spite might come from their own malevolent will in life, or can be instilled by necromantic rituals, typically involving the desecration of burial sites. Wights usually haunt burial grounds, catacombs, or other places of the dead. Their hunger is targeted toward the living—those whose pumping hearts and ruddy warmth inspire visceral hatred.

As many types of wights exist as types of people from which they might be created. Hulking brutes, skittering sneaks, and cunning tinkers all make for different wights with different niches to fill. The environment, too, plays a part in determining a wight's special abilities and defenses. Frost wights, for instance, can be found in parts of the world where exposure is a common end and the resentment of being left alone in the wild is a common source of spite. Durable and sustained by void energy, wights can last in harsh environments without decaying the way some lesser undead do.

A single wight can wreak significant havoc if it is compelled to rise from its tomb. Because creatures slain under a wight's curse can become wights as well, all it takes is a single wight and a handful of unlucky graveyard visitors to create a veritable horde of these undead. Thus, canny priests and adventurers know that the best solution to a wight problem is swift and total eradication. Care must be taken, though, to destroy wight spawn before attempting to destroy the parent wight, for spawn without a master gain the ability to create spawn of their own.

Bloody Wail.name: Bloody Wail
Bloody Wail.description:

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature bleeds from their ears and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature bleeds from their ears and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature takes a –2 status penalty to saving throws against drain life.

Drain Life.name: Drain Life
Drain Life.description:
When the warshard wight damages a living creature with a melee Strike using an unarmed attack or its bound weapon, the warshard wight gains 5 temporary Hit Points and the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20|options:inflicts:drained] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Further damage dealt by the warshard wight increases the drained condition value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.LRIYUFQ7FE9H4RWD]{Effect: Drain Life}

Warshard Wight Spawn.name: Warshard Wight Spawn

Trigger Two or more non-plant creatures step onto the moss pond

Effect The moss pond ripples oddly as its connection to the Plane of Wood intensifies. Each creature on the pond must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:17|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:prone] save or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A creature who critically fails the save also takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage from the fall. The pond then rolls initiative.

Odvolos.name: 狂憎魔 Odvolos
Odvolos.publicNotes: 当帝国在衰落中虚张声势、煽动者把持着共和政体时，审查魔鬼便会散播燃烧着的无知灰烬，将其作为抚慰人心的面纱来掩盖历史与因果的复杂性。这些魔鬼狂热地侍奉着地狱，寻找任何能被解读为违反地狱教义的内容，将其视为可憎之物并应当被立即销毁。会造成麻烦的往昔报道、将信徒带离阿斯摩蒂斯之道的真相、会为那些可能堕入魔鬼诱惑之人带来希望的话语——这些都将成为狂憎魔的仇恨火炬的燃料，在墨迹与羊皮纸的余烬上熊熊燃烧。
Odvolos.allSaves: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态，对抗情绪效果时所有豁免-1点状态

Fevered Consciousness.name: 狂热意识 Fevered Consciousness
Fevered Consciousness.description: 狂憎魔忽略灰烬、火焰和烟雾带来的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]或对察觉的惩罚。

-1 Status to All Saves vs. Emotion Effec.name: 对抗情绪效果时所有豁免-1点状态 -1 Status to All Saves vs. Emotion Effects

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Purge Records.name: 清除记录 Purge Records
Purge Records.description:
触发 狂憎魔能看到或听到、并且距离其15尺之内的生物通过卷轴施放法术或者启动魔典

效果 狂憎魔向着该生物快步，并且作出长矛打击。若打击造成重击，触发动作会被打断。

Shroud of Burning Pages.name: 燃烧书页之罩 Shroud of Burning Pages
Shroud of Burning Pages.description: 15尺。狂憎魔周围环绕着燃烧的书页和烧焦的羊皮纸构成的灵光，这会如同烟雾一般提供@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。灵光内的生物会在察觉检定上承受-2点环境减值，并且在灵光内结束自身回合的生物必须成功通过@Check[reflex|dc:22|options:area-effect]豁免，否则该生物携带或持有的任何具有书面信息的物品将会承受@Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]]伤害。魔法物品和宗教文本免疫该效果。

Pyre's Mercy.name: 火葬的怜悯 Pyre's Mercy
Pyre's Mercy.description:
狂憎魔对30尺内的一个生物尝试[[/act demoralize]]。若狂憎魔成功，该生物在处于惊惧状态之时还会获得对火焰的弱点5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.u3Qy9t7RuE4wKV0O]{效果: 火葬的怜悯 Pyre's Mercy}

Torchbearer.name: 火炬手 Torchbearer
Torchbearer.description: 狂憎魔持用的穿刺武器会获得魔法特征，该武器在打击成功时能造成额外1d4点火焰伤害，并且在重击时能造成1d8点持续火焰伤害。

Drunken Stumble.name: Drunken Stumble
Drunken Stumble.description:
Trigger The drunken Isgeri Slayer is hit with an attack that deals physical damage

Effect The drunken slayer stumbles away from the blow. They gain resistance 2 to the damage of the triggering attack and they can Step. They also take a –1 circumstance penalty to AC for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.QVLX06QevxTcuZxU]{Effect: Drunken Stumble}

Hunt Prey.name: Hunt Prey
Hunt Prey.description:
The Isgeri Slayer designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey.

The slayer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] the prey and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the prey.

The first time the slayer hits the designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d6 precision damage. The slayer also ignores the penalty for making ranged attacks within their second range increment. These effects last until the poacher uses Hunt Prey again.

Denounce Heretic.name: Denounce Heretic
Denounce Heretic.description:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet who the deathless acolyte can see and who doesn't worship Urgathoa casts a divine spell

Effect The deathless acolyte attempts to counteract the triggering spell using their spell attack modifier and a counteract rank of 2. If the deathless acolyte fails to counteract the spell, the caster is temporarily immune to further uses of Denounce Heretic for 24 hours.

Field of Undeath.name: Field of Undeath
Field of Undeath.description: 20 feet. Allies within the aura who have void healing gain fast healing 2. When a creature within the aura would receive vitality healing, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or receive no healing from the effect.

Draconic Fumecrux.name: 龙形烟骸 Draconic Fumecrux
Draconic Fumecrux.publicNotes:
该生物是将青年精金龙的头颅用于烟骸仪式的结果。与大多数烟骸不同，龙形烟骸保留了其生前同类的部分独特魔法。

通过研究地狱亡冠（Hellcrown）和活化头颅（Beheaded），切利亚斯法师创造出了两者的融合体。多年的实验以创造出烟骸而告终，这是以被斩首的腐烂巨兽头颅为顶的硫磺幽魂。该生物的制造过程正被频繁地尝试，用以作为对抗安多安（Andoran）的另一件战争武器。

Desiccated Boulder Breath.name: 干涸巨岩吐息 Desiccated Boulder Breath
Desiccated Boulder Breath.description:
龙形烟骸向前喷出大量岩石，其中一部分是实体物质，余下的则是虚能。这些岩石造成@Damage[4d8[bludgeoning],4d8[void]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。

龙形烟骸在[[/br 1d4 #Recharge Desiccated Boulder Breath]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用干涸巨岩吐息。

Hellfume Body.name: 地狱烟躯 Hellfume Body
Hellfume Body.description: 烟骸的躯体由充满虚能的地狱烟气构成。当生物被烟骸活吞且正在屏息时，它在自己的回合内攻击或施法会减少3轮剩余空气而非2轮。

Spit Up.name: 用力喷吐 Spit Up
Spit Up.description:
需求 龙形烟骸已经活吞了一个生物

效果 龙形烟骸吐出被活吞的一个生物，将其抛飞至多40尺远。该生物承受等同于它被抛飞距离的钝击伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。若该生物的落点位于其他生物占据的空间，则其他生物会被推离5尺并承受@Damage[(3d8+4)[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。无论被活吞的生物的体型如何，烟骸每次用力喷吐吐出的生物数量也无法多于一个，而且最近被活吞的生物会优先被用力喷吐吐出。

Blinding Spray.name: Blinding Spray
Blinding Spray.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20] (trained) to disable the blade that bursts the bladder
Blinding Spray.hazarddescription: A bladder of powdered peppers is secreted in a compartment above the door.

No Orphans Allowed.name: No Orphans Allowed
No Orphans Allowed.description:
Trigger The door is opened

Effect The powder sprays in a burst that fills the square in front of the door and all adjacent squares in the orphans' dormitory. Any creature in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21] save.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 minute.

Elite Ort.name: Elite Ort
Elite Ort.publicNotes:
These shapeless masses of quivering flesh are the least of devilkind. Pathetic creatures from Hell's first layer, orts roam alongside damned and suffering souls. Nessaris can combine the essence of a mob of orts to concentrate their collective wickedness within a single form, granting it an infernal sentience and transforming it into a more powerful devil (see the nessari's Shape Devils ability).

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks.

Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly orts perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as infantry and contract devils, while the greatest nessaris command entire infernal armies.

Asmodeus stands at the apex of the structure he created, but the layers below him are marked by a constant jockeying for position. Most diabolic plans ultimately serve to improve the schemer's place in the hierarchy.

Fiendish Order.name: Fiendish Order
Fiendish Order.description: 30 feet. An elite ort is ripe enough to be shaped into another, more powerful devil and gives off an aura of superiority. Each allied ort in the aura gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Subservience.name: Subservience
Subservience.description:
Orts have little drive of their own, but other devils can take command of them. A non-ort devil can issue a command to all orts within 60 feet of it with a single action, which has the auditory and concentrate traits. The devil picks one of the following orders orts can understand, and the orts follow that order. The command and its effects end once the commander is out of the ort's sight, when a new command is issued by the same or another devil, or when the ort dies.

  • Kill The ort attacks one target the commander singles out and gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the target.
  • Defend The ort circles the commander and attacks any creature that comes near. It gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saves.
  • Fetch The ort gains a +10–foot circumstance bonus to its Speed and attempts to get an object or person the commander singles out. It attacks anyone and anything that gets in the way.
  • Work The ort performs drudge work dictated by the commander.

Slashing Rune.name: Slashing Rune
Slashing Rune.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:25] (trained) to silently erase the rune, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the rune
Slashing Rune.hazarddescription: An invisible rune creates knives of force if someone tries to bypass the lock.

Slash.name: Slash
Slash.description:
Trigger A creature attempts a Thievery check to Pick the Lock

Effect Knives of force deal @Damage[(4d8+18)[slashing]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). On a failure, the creature also takes a –1 penalty to Dex-based skills for 1 hour.

Disarming Dummy.name: Disarming Dummy
Disarming Dummy.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to jam the rotor or @Check[athletics|dc:25] to knock the dummy over
Disarming Dummy.hazarddescription: A leather strap on the dummy's mechanical arm swings around, knocking items out the hands of anyone adjacent.

Hold On!.name: Hold On!
Hold On!.description:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the trap

Effect The trap makes a single Athletics check with a +17 modifier to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the creature.

Bite of the Asp Stance.name: Bite of the Asp Stance
Bite of the Asp Stance.description:
Requirements Sister Endreah is wielding an asp coil

Effect Sister Endreah is an expert at using her sword in close quarters. Her asp coil loses the reach weapon property, but she can make asp coil Strikes instead of fist Strikes when she uses Flurry of Blows. Claw of pain also applies to these asp coil Strikes when in this stance.

Claw of Pain.name: Claw of Pain
Claw of Pain.description: When Sister Endreah targets the same creature with two Strikes from her Flurry of Blows, she can cause lingering pain. If either Strike hits and deals damage, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save or take @Damage[1d4[persistent,mental]] damage (and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a critical failure).

Flurry of Blows.name: Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description: Sister Endreah makes two fist Strikes, applying her multiple attack penalty as normal. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

Illcayna Alonnor.name: Illcayna Alonnor
Illcayna Alonnor.allSaves: +1 status bonus to all saves vs. holy effects

Bleeding Heart of Urgathoa.name: Bleeding Heart of Urgathoa
Bleeding Heart of Urgathoa.description: Red ichor drips from the heart-shaped warshard embedded in Illcayna's chest. This warshard functions as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wtm4JdxeTLQi3zQI]{Symbol of Conflict (Greater)}, except it's attuned only to Urgathoa. As long as Illcayna exists, non-Urgathoans can't use the warshard even if it's removed. If Illcayna dies, the warshard acts as a regular greater symbol of conflict.

Reaper's Sigh.name: Reaper's Sigh
Reaper's Sigh.description: Illcayna is fused with Reaper's Sigh, granting her a +4 circumstance bonus to her Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the scythe. This bonus is reduced to +2 for 1 round after she's critically hit with a slashing weapon.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Holy Effects.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Holy Effects

Field of Unholy Undeath.name: Field of Unholy Undeath
Field of Unholy Undeath.description: 40 feet. Undead allies within the aura gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. If the ally has void healing, they also gain fast healing 5. A living creature who doesn't worship Urgathoa takes @Damage[6d6[void]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] save) when they enter or start their turn in the aura. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, that creature becomes temporarily immune to the aura for 1 day.

Life to Unlife.name: Life to Unlife
Life to Unlife.description:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger A creature within 30 feet that Illcayna can observe Casts a divine Spell with the healing trait

Effect Illcayna sadistically twists the healing magic against the living. She expends a prepared spell of the same rank as the triggering spell and then attempts to counteract the triggering spell using Religion. If she successfully counteracts the spell, Illcayna consumes the magic and regurgitates it as a 3-action harm spell of the rank of the countered spell.

Share Blessings.name: Share Blessings
Share Blessings.description: When Illcayna is destroyed, she explodes in a blast of infectious rot. All creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] are exposed to pallid plague.

Pallid Plague.name: Pallid Plague
Pallid Plague.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:27]

Stage 1 carrier (3 days)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d8[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d8[void]] damage, doomed 1, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[4d8[void]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}, and drained 1 (1 day)

Stage 5 @Damage[4d8[void]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 day)

Stage 6 dead.

A creature that dies while infected with pallid plague rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.DBTbqI9QQRtlJwWh]{Wight}.

Reap.name: Reap
Reap.description: Illcayna makes a Reaper's Sigh Strike and compares the attack roll result to the ACs of two foes who must both be within her melee reach. Roll damage only once, and apply it to each creature hit. Reap counts as two attacks for Illcayna's multiple attack penalty.

Wake the Dead.name: Wake the Dead
Wake the Dead.description:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements Illcayna is adjacent to a creature that died within the last minute

Effect Illcayna animates the dead with a touch of her hand. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:29] save or arise as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.DBTbqI9QQRtlJwWh]{Wight}. These wights automatically become loyal to Illcayna and independently act in her interest and follow her command until destroyed.

Hestlebeth.name: Hestlebeth
Hestlebeth.publicNotes:
A jailer's primary responsibility is to keep prisoners from escaping. Jailers must often use force, or the threat of force, to keep their charges in line, as even the most carefully crafted cells, manacles, or chains can fail with time and persistence when the prisoners have the will to attempt an escape.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

+1 Bonus on Perception to Find Concealed.name: +1 Bonus on Perception to Find Concealed Objects

Efficient Capture.name: Efficient Capture
Efficient Capture.description:
Requirements The jailer has manacles in hand and is adjacent to a creature

Effect The jailer attempts to bind the creature's wrists or ankles with the manacles. If the jailer succeeds at an attack roll with a @Check[efficient-capture|against:ac]{+9} modifier against the target's AC, they apply the manacles.

Hunter's Fatigue.name: Hunter's Fatigue
Hunter's Fatigue.description: Having fought undead nonstop for the entire day, both Hellknights have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition. The condition goes away as usual with a full night's rest.

Intimidating Strike.name: Intimidating Strike
Intimidating Strike.description: The jailer makes a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit.

Subdue Prisoners.name: Subdue Prisoners
Subdue Prisoners.description: The jailer doesn't take the normal penalty for making a nonlethal attack when attacking with their club.

Skeletal Hellknight Bonesinger.name: 骷髅地狱骑士吟骨者 Skeletal Hellknight Bonesinger
Skeletal Hellknight Bonesinger.publicNotes:
部分不死地狱骑士能操控自身躯体或他人身上的骨骼，它们主要凭借此能力暂时强化自身和召集援军。尽管与其他同类一般属于不死生物，但这些吟骨者具有足够的智能加入到仍活着的同袍之列，不过它们普遍会遭到生者的排斥与回绝。

地狱骑士的尸体偶尔会重新站起来继续它们的战斗。这仅是地狱的不死士兵中的一例。

Call to Arms.name: 战斗号令 Call to Arms
Call to Arms.description: 骷髅地狱骑士吟骨者向自己的胸腔敲击三次，发出巨大且不详的骸骨碰撞声。@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内的所有无心智骷髅必须使用其反应动作，以行走靠近吟骨者。

For the Cause.name: 为了事业 For the Cause
For the Cause.description:
频率 1次/日

需求 骷髅地狱骑士吟骨者剩余的生命值低于一半

效果 吟骨者伸手以死灵魔法活化周遭的死者，并将其拉入到自己体内。吟骨者选择@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]内由其控制的至多3个具有仆从特征的无心智骷髅，并将其摧毁。每个被摧毁的骷髅会为吟骨者恢复@Damage[2d6[healing,void]|shortLabel]生命值。

Invoke Reckoning.name: 唤骨清算 Invoke Reckoning
Invoke Reckoning.description:
频率 1次/轮

需求 骷髅地狱骑士吟骨者的上个动作是以近战打击对敌人造成伤害

效果 吟骨者将它刚刚伤害过的生物的骨骼扯出身体，释放出一股虚能脉冲。该生物承受@Damage[4d8[void]]伤害，并且必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:23]豁免。

大成功 该生物不会承受伤害。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受全额伤害。

大失败 该生物承受全额伤害并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}。

Umok Beastspeaker Circle.name: 乌莫克兽语者结社 Umok Beastspeaker Circle
Umok Beastspeaker Circle.publicNotes:
自地精血战期间那场焚毁尖叫森林的惨痛野火之后，乌莫克的侏儒就变得无法对火焰置之不理。为了保护家园免遭纵火，许多乌莫克侏儒学会了与动物沟通，动物们能凭借本能迅速嗅出未经许可产生的烟与火。两者相互协作以守护城镇的安全，在威胁临近之时，动物们能够充当城镇的预警系统。

数位乌莫克兽语者加入战争，利用他们的原能魔法以及和动物们的联系来对抗切利亚斯的大军。他们强大的魔法被用于召唤荒野兽群，从威胁家园和平的暴力中守护依斯嘉，以原能之力对抗魔族。

Animal Empathy.name: 动物认同 Animal Empathy
Animal Empathy.description: 兽语者结社能向动物提出问题并得到回答，也能对动物使用交涉技能。

Muster Animals.name: 召集动物 Muster Animals
Muster Animals.description: 乌莫克兽语者结社召唤一群野生动物，攻击60尺内@Template[type:burst|distance:10]中的所有生物。动物造成@Damage[3d8[slashing]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic]豁免）。当乌莫克兽语者结社减少至2部分时，该区域降低为@Template[type:burst|distance:5]。

Staff Assault.name: 木杖袭击 Staff Assault
Staff Assault.description:
频率 1次/轮

效果 乌莫克兽语者结社双手握住他们的木杖，并对@Template[type:emanation|distance:5]内的所有敌人发起攻击，这具有@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic]豁免。造成的伤害取决于动作数量。

1 @Damage[(1d8+1)[bludgeoning]] 伤害

2 @Damage[(2d8+6)[bludgeoning]] 伤害

3 @Damage[(2d8+10)[bludgeoning]] 伤害

Troop Spellcasting.name: 部队施法 Troop Spellcasting
Troop Spellcasting.description: 当乌莫克兽语者结社施法时，每个成员会共同努力，施放出比任何人单独施法更具威力版本的法术。当施放的法术的区域为爆发、锥形或线形，且法术不具有持续时间时，将该法术的区域扩大。通常影响至少半径10尺爆发区域（半径小于该数值的法术不受影响）的法术的半径增加5尺。通常长度为15尺或更小范围的锥形或线形法术的长度增加5尺，长度大于该长度的锥形或线形法术则长度增加10尺。

Play Time.name: Play Time
Play Time.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:19] (trained) to exorcise the spirits of the toy box, @Check[athletics|dc:20] (trained) to hold the toy box closed momentarily, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:21] (trained) to convince the spirits that play time is over; three total success are required to disable the haunt
Play Time.hazarddescription: An old, dusty toy box creaks open and forcefully expels a series of cracked and broken toys.
Play Time.routine: (1 action) The toy box belches forth a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] of toys, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (chosen randomly each time) with a @Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save.
Play Time.reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the room or if the toy box is destroyed. After 1 hour, if the toy box remains, the haunt reactivates. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day. The haunt is permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer in area D5 is destroyed.

Terrifying Toy Box.name: Terrifying Toy Box
Terrifying Toy Box.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the toy box

Effect The toy box lid slowly opens with a groan, revealing a yawning chasm into nothingness. Each creature who can see the toy box must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 while the haunt is active.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

Swiftrun Clergy.name: 疾流村修士团 Swiftrun Clergy
Swiftrun Clergy.publicNotes:
疾流村是信奉着埃拉斯蒂尔的小型聚居地，其规模勉强可以称之为村庄。村内的祭司们奉献于社区与和平、自然与养育。然而，言语与理解不足以解决事端，必须执起武器守护他们的社区的时刻总会来临。

疾流村修士团以其农耕技艺而非魔法技术而闻名，但他们那质朴的乡村生活方式不应当让任何人误以为这些人无力自卫。每位祭司都拥有古老神猎的神力，以及更有利于发挥埃拉斯蒂尔偏好武器——长弓——的精准射击技能。尽管这些祭司并不渴望鲜血，更愿意将时日用于照料作物与社区，但在必要之时他们会准备好运用自身的技能保卫家园。

Longbow Volley.name: 长弓齐射 Longbow Volley
Longbow Volley.description: 疾流村修士团拔出长弓，然后以齐射的形式发动远程攻击。齐射对60尺内的@Template[type:burst|distance:10]造成@Damage[3d6[piercing]|options:area-damage]伤害，这具有@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect]豁免。当部队降低至2部分时，该区域降低至@Template[type:burst|distance:5]。

Swift Daggers.name: 迅击匕首 Swift Daggers
Swift Daggers.description:
频率 1次/轮

效果 疾流村修士团迅速用匕首袭击@Template[type:emanation|distance:5]内的每个敌人，这具有@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect]豁免。造成的伤害取决于动作数量。

1 @Damage[(1d4+1)[piercing]|options:area-damage]伤害

2 @Damage[(2d4+7)[piercing]|options:area-damage]伤害

3 @Damage[(2d4+10)[piercing]|options:area-damage]伤害

Troop Spellcasting.name: 部队施法 Troop Spellcasting
Troop Spellcasting.description: 当疾流村修士团施法时，部队成员会共同努力，施放出比任何人单独施法更具威力版本的法术。当施放的法术的区域为爆发、锥形或线形，且法术不具有持续时间时，将该法术的区域扩大。通常影响至少半径10尺爆发区域（半径小于该数值的法术不受影响）的法术的半径增加5尺。通常长度为15尺或更小范围的锥形或线形法术的长度增加5尺，长度大于该长度的锥形或线形法术则长度增加10尺。

Stumpfield War Chanter Choir.name: 树桩地战歌合唱团 Stumpfield War Chanter Choir
Stumpfield War Chanter Choir.publicNotes: 就像大多数地精一样，树桩地的地精艺术家也热爱好听的歌曲。尽管他们完全算不上是战士，但这些地精也已经拿起屠狗刀，要为依斯嘉的解放而战。不过，在尖兵作战遭遇中，他们作为部队资产的主要优势是能够用战歌鼓舞盟友和扰乱敌人。

In Our Wake, Hell Will Break!.name: 我们觉醒，地狱将破！ In Our Wake, Hell Will Break!
In Our Wake, Hell Will Break!.description: 30尺。战歌合唱团不断地歌唱和鼓劲来激励他们的破狱者盟友。灵光内的每个盟友生物会在对抗心灵效果的豁免检定中获得+1点环境加值。

Goblins Slice and Goblins Dice!.name: 地精切片又切块！ Goblins Slice and Goblins Dice!
Goblins Slice and Goblins Dice!.description:
1至3

频率 1次/轮

效果 战歌合唱团挥舞屠狗刀，攻击@Template[type:emanation|distance:5]内的每个敌人，这具有@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic]豁免。造成的伤害取决于动作数量。

1 @Damage[(1d6+2)[slashing]]伤害

2 @Damage[(2d6+8)[slashing]]伤害

3 @Damage[(3d6+11)[slashing]]伤害

Hark! The Goblins Chanters Sing!.name: 听！地精歌者唱！ Hark! The Goblins Chanters Sing!
Hark! The Goblins Chanters Sing!.description: 战歌合唱团突然唱起一首熟悉的歌曲，但旋律却很陌生。位于30尺内、数量等同于部队当前剩余部分数值的敌人必须尝试@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。无论结果如何，目标都会在1分钟内临时免疫该能力。失败的目标会因为被战歌合唱团的韵律分散注意力而陷入持续1轮的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}）。

Sarcovalt Swarm.name: 腐鹫蝇集群 Sarcovalt Swarm
Sarcovalt Swarm.publicNotes:
在大多数情况下，人们几乎不可能只遭遇单只腐鹫蝇。更有可能发生的情况是，成群的厄加图娅的恶心造物会围困某个不幸的村庄，而这些生物也足够机敏到能躲过剿灭它们的全力尝试。

在多元宇宙中，很少有生物能比腐鹫蝇更加怪异和令人作呕，这是一种长着苍蝇身躯和无肉的秃鹫颅骨的魔族。尽管这种体长约为2尺的生物看似无法构成任何威胁，但腐鹫蝇集群能够吞没整个村庄。腐鹫蝇的头部与躯体仿佛是两个完全独立的实体，它们用喙捕捉吞食的任何东西都会在数小时后被呕吐出来，化为一滩腐烂凝结的淤泥。
Sarcovalt Swarm.allSaves: 对抗死亡效果时所有豁免+1点状态

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Death Effects.name: 对抗死亡效果时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Death Effects

Aura of Blight.name: 疫病灵光 Aura of Blight
Aura of Blight.description:
15尺。腐鹫蝇集群被致病瘴气所笼罩着。进入灵光或在灵光内结束自身回合的敌人必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:25]豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响，并且在1分钟内临时免疫灵光。

失败 直至其下个回合结束为止，该生物对抗疾病效果的豁免检定会承受-1点环境减值。

大失败 直至其下个回合结束为止，该生物对抗疾病效果的豁免检定会承受-2点环境减值并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 2}。

Droning Waste.name: 嗡鸣滋扰 Droning Waste
Droning Waste.description: 集群振翅的嗡鸣声产生了邪秽之音，让听到声响的人感到头晕目眩。位于@Template[type:emanation|distance:15]内的每个生物必须尝试@Check[will|dc:27]豁免。失败时，会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}并且攻击检定承受-1点环境减值，持续至它的下个回合开始为止（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}）。

Heads Will Roll.name: 鹫首滚落 Heads Will Roll
Heads Will Roll.description: 集群将其所有头部与身体分离，如雨般洒向30尺内半径为@Template[type:burst|distance:10]的敌人身上。每个头部都会造成坠落伤害，就如同从20尺高坠落一般，对它洒到的任何生物造成伤害，否则便会由自身承受伤害。在坠落后，若有生物处于坠落头部的触及之内，头部便会尝试咬住该生物。若这些啃咬造成大成功，头部就可以立即尝试对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]。

Swarming Bites.name: 集群啃咬 Swarming Bites
Swarming Bites.description: 集群占据空间内的每个敌人承受@Damage[4d6[piercing],2d4[persistent,bleed]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic]豁免）。

Gredress Tilnanos.name: Gredress Tilnanos
Gredress Tilnanos.publicNotes:
Demonologists can pull a creature from the Outer Rifts and bend it to their will... for a time.

Hidden secrets and occult powers have an irresistible lure for many. Since the majority of these NPCs are spellcasters, consider using alternative spell lists to adjust their themes.

Diabolic Certitude.name: Diabolic Certitude
Diabolic Certitude.description:
Some signifers are so assured of their power to control devils that they sometimes reach too far. When Gredress publicly espouses the superiority of Hell, she gains a +1 status bonus to skill checks, AC, and saves for 1 day. These bonuses don't apply against devils. At the end of the day, Gredress must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save or take a –1 status penalty to skill checks, AC, and saves against devils for 1 day (or –2 on a critical failure).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.6bGS19fnwbv4E7mn]{Effect: Diabolic Certitude}

Breach the Pit.name: Breach the Pit
Breach the Pit.description:
Requirements Gredress's last action was to cast a non-cantrip spell

Effect Gredress siphons energy drawn from Hell into her weapon. Until the end of the turn, the weapon deals an extra 2d6 damage.

Roll 1d20 to determine the type:

1–4 cold

5–12 fire

13–16 poison

17–20 void.

Devil Summoning.name: Devil Summoning
Devil Summoning.description: Gredress can cast a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.29ytKctjg7qSW2ff]{Summon Fiend} arcane spell to summon a devil. To do so, she must sacrifice two 4th-rank prepared spells and voluntarily take @Damage[4d12[mental]] damage that can't be reduced or prevented. If Gredress is unable to Sustain the Spell, including if she's knocked out or killed, the spell continues, but the GM rolls a @Check[flat|dc:10] each round, ending the spell on a failure.

Erinys Sister Wight.name: Erinys Sister Wight
Erinys Sister Wight.publicNotes:
Wights are intelligent undead spawned through inescapable cycles of spite. This spite might come from their own malevolent will in life, or can be instilled by necromantic rituals, typically involving the desecration of burial sites. Wights usually haunt burial grounds, catacombs, or other places of the dead. Their hunger is targeted toward the living—those whose pumping hearts and ruddy warmth inspire visceral hatred.

As many types of wights exist as types of people from which they might be created. Hulking brutes, skittering sneaks, and cunning tinkers all make for different wights with different niches to fill. The environment, too, plays a part in determining a wight's special abilities and defenses. Frost wights, for instance, can be found in parts of the world where exposure is a common end and the resentment of being left alone in the wild is a common source of spite. Durable and sustained by void energy, wights can last in harsh environments without decaying the way some lesser undead do.

A single wight can wreak significant havoc if it is compelled to rise from its tomb. Because creatures slain under a wight's curse can become wights as well, all it takes is a single wight and a handful of unlucky graveyard visitors to create a veritable horde of these undead. Thus, canny priests and adventurers know that the best solution to a wight problem is swift and total eradication. Care must be taken, though, to destroy wight spawn before attempting to destroy the parent wight, for spawn without a master gain the ability to create spawn of their own.

Grave Weapon.name: Grave Weapon
Grave Weapon.description: The wight is bound to the darts she was buried with.

Final Spite.name: Final Spite
Final Spite.description:
Trigger The wight is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The wight makes a Strike before being destroyed. This Strike can inflict corrupting spite, but fueled by spite doesn't apply.

Fueled by Spite.name: Fueled by Spite
Fueled by Spite.description: Each time a creature loses Hit Points due to a corrupting spite curse the wight inflicted, the wight gains 3 temporary Hit Points.

Claw of Pain.name: Claw of Pain
Claw of Pain.description: When the sister wight targets the same creature with two Strikes from her Flurry of Blows, she can cause lingering pain. If either Strike hits and deals damage, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save or take @Damage[1d4[persistent,mental]] damage (and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a critical failure).

Corrupting Spite.name: Corrupting Spite
Corrupting Spite.description:
The wight's unarmed attacks and bound weapons inflict a curse that makes a creature grow weak and spiteful. If a wight inflicts corrupting spite on a creature already afflicted by it, the victim attempts a new save, ignoring the result if it's better than a failure.

A living humanoid that dies while under the curse rises as a wight after [[/gmr 1d4 #Wight Spawn Timer]]{1d4 rounds}, controlled by the wight that killed it. The wight spawn can't inflict corrupting spite and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. If its creator dies or after roughly a month of existence, the new wight becomes autonomous and turns into a normal wight

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:17];

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and doesn't treat any creatures as allies (1 round)

Stage 3 As stage 2, except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round)

Stage 4 As stage 2, except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4} (1 round).

Flurry of Blows.name: Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description: The sister wight makes two fist Strikes, applying her multiple attack penalty as normal. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

Aurocan.name: 蒸汽钢牛 Aurocan
Aurocan.publicNotes:
在战场上，可以通过聆听声音来辨识敌人的种类。步兵行军时携带的武器与盾牌会叮当作响。骑兵的标志是马蹄奔腾时叩响的鼓点声。而统御着庞大巨兽的军队则从来不会试图压抑那些令人毛骨悚然的尖锐咆哮。

没有任何声响能比齿轮持续转动和蒸汽喷涌嘶鸣的声音更让人警惕，因为会伴随这些声响登场的只会是蒸汽钢牛：一种以巨大的六足公牛为外形的机械造物，它在被摧毁时极易发生爆炸。它最强大的能力在于头颅可以与身体分离，然后从空中降下滚热的蒸汽。

Wind-Up.name: 上发条 Wind-Up
Wind-Up.description:
24小时，[[/act disable-device dc=24]]，待机

发条装置若要行动，就必须由另一个生物使用其专属钥匙上紧发条。这个过程需要1分钟。发条上紧后，它会在列明的时间内保持运作，通常为24小时；此后它会无法感知周围环境，也无法行动，直至再次上紧发条。部分发条装置的能力会消耗其剩余运作时间。它们无法消耗超过剩余量的时间，并且会在剩余时间降至0时立即停机。若不清楚发条装置上次上紧发条的时间，大多数发条装置的保管者会在固定时间为所有装置上发条，通常是上午8点。

若发条装置的上发条条目中列有待机，它便能以三动作活动进入待机模式。待机时不会减少运作时间，但仍能感知周围环境（察觉承受-2减值）。它无法行动，只有一个例外：当它察觉到生物时，可以用反应动作退出待机（若适用则投掷先攻）。

生物可以尝试解除装置来松开发条装置的发条（DC列在上发条条目中）。每次成功都会使发条装置失去1小时运作时间。即使发条装置处于待机模式，也可以这么做。

Explosive End.name: 终结爆破 Explosive End
Explosive End.description:
触发 蒸汽钢牛的HP降至0点

效果 蒸汽钢牛爆炸。@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内的每个生物会承受@Damage[3d12[bludgeoning],3d8[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic]豁免）。大失败时，该生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。

Blistering Touch.name: 高热之触 Blistering Touch
Blistering Touch.description: 蒸汽钢牛将部分用于提供动力的蒸汽输送到体内，加热其金属框架。在接下来的1分钟内，其近战打击造成额外1d6点火焰伤害。

Head of Steam.name: 蒸汽头颅 Head of Steam
Head of Steam.description:
需求 蒸汽钢牛在过去的2轮内使用了高热之触，并且头颅连接在躯体上

效果 蒸汽钢牛喷出一团蒸汽，其头颅随之分离。头颅占据5尺方格，飞行速度为15尺。作为该动作的一部分，以及在后续的轮内蒸汽钢牛每次维持该能力之时，头颅能至多以其速度飞行，并且在其移动之时向正下方喷射蒸汽。在头颅飞行路径之上，且位于其正下方不超过5尺距离内的生物，均会承受@Damage[4d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]豁免）。豁免失败时，该生物还会因蒸汽而陷入持续1轮的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]）。

\n

在头颅处于分离状态时，蒸汽钢牛无法作出角打击，但是仍能正常执行所有其他动作。其头颅具有27的AC，硬度10，与蒸汽钢牛相同的豁免、免疫、弱点和抗力。若头颅在单次攻击中承受了20点伤害，它就会坠落到地上并损坏，且蒸汽钢牛会在1轮内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。若头颅重新进入到蒸汽钢牛占据的空间内，它就会重新连接在躯体上。

Ezio Gaeta.name: Ezio Gaeta
Ezio Gaeta.hp: coffin restoration, fast healing 7, void healing

Children of the Night.name: Children of the Night
Children of the Night.description: Ezio's presence brings forth creatures of the night to do his bidding. Ezio can give telepathic orders to these creatures as long as they're within 100 feet, but they can't communicate back. Ezio prefers to keep the company of rat swarms.

Cloud of Plague.name: Cloud of Plague
Cloud of Plague.description:
Trigger Ezio is reduced to 0 HP

Effect Ezio's body explodes in a bloody mist that carries a deadly plague. Each living creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or contract choking death at stage 1 (stage 2 on a critical failure). Ezio bursts forth from the corpse of the first creature to die of this affliction, fully healed, but if all affected creatures are cured of the disease, Ezio is permanently destroyed.

Coffin Restoration.name: Coffin Restoration
Coffin Restoration.description: Unlike other undead, a vampire isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If its body rests in its coffin for 1 hour, the vampire gains 1 HP, after which its fast healing begins to function normally.

Hypnotic Gaze.name: Hypnotic Gaze
Hypnotic Gaze.description: 30 feet. Even when he's not attempting to Dominate a creature, Ezio uses his power over others' minds to subtly befuddle them, helping enable his plots. Creatures in the aura take a –1 status penalty to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} and Perception DCs against Ezio. When a creature ends its turn in Ezio's aura, it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. On a failure, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round on a critical failure).

Vampire Vulnerabilities.name: Vampire Vulnerabilities
Vampire Vulnerabilities.description:
All vampires possess the following vulnerabilities.

  • Compulsions Vampires are creatures with strange and unknowable compulsions. A typical vampire can't voluntarily cross running water unless they're transported while they hide within their coffin, nor can they enter a private dwelling unless invited in by someone with the authority to do so. At your discretion, vampires might have different compulsions—a pirate vampire might not be able to set foot on solid ground without being invited, for example. The vampire can still be forced to do these things and might be able to overcome their compulsion just as they do their revulsion.
  • Revulsion A vampire can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option. To brandish garlic or a religious symbol, a creature must Interact to do so, and it remains brandished for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the vampire involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, a vampire can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Stake A wooden stake driven through a vampire's heart drops the vampire to 0 HP and prevents them from healing above 0 HP, even in their coffin. Staking a vampire requires 3 actions and works only if the vampire is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If the stake is removed, the vampire can heal above 0 HP again, and if they're in their coffin, the 1-hour rest period begins once the stake is removed. If the vampire's head is severed and anointed with holy water while the stake is in place, the vampire is destroyed.
  • Sunlight If exposed to direct sunlight, a vampire immediately becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. The slowed value increases by 1 each time the vampire ends their turn in sunlight, and the condition ends when they're no longer in sunlight. If the vampire loses all their actions in this way, they're destroyed. Due to their supernatural aversion to light, vampires don't cast shadows or show a reflection in mirrors

Biting Flies.name: Biting Flies
Biting Flies.description: Each creature that shares a space with Ezio takes @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save. On a critical failure, Ezio also gains the benefits of Drinking that creature's Blood.

Change Shape.name: Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
Ezio transforms into a swarm of Tiny flies. While in this form, he has the swarm trait and gains weakness 7 to area and splash damage. He has a land Speed of 20 feet and a fly Speed of 30 feet, and can fit into spaces only a few inches wide, moving his constituent creatures through the gap. He can't make any of his normal Strikes but gains the Biting Flies action.

Biting Flies 1 Each creature that shares a space with Ezio takes @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save. On a critical failure, Ezio also gains the benefits of Drinking that creature's Blood.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Create Servitor.name: Create Servitor
Create Servitor.description:
If a creature dies after being reduced to 0 HP by Drink Blood, Ezio can turn this victim into a vampire servitor by donating some of their own blood to the victim and burying the victim in earth for 3 nights.

A vampiric servitor is compelled to obey its creator, but if Ezio controls too many vampiric servitors at once (as determined by the GM), or if the servitor is a higher level than Ezio that created it, strong-willed servitors can free themselves by succeeding at a @Check[will|dc:25] saving throw.

Dominate.name: Dominate
Dominate.description:
Ezio can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait (@Check[will|dc:23]). A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to that vampire's Dominate for 24 hours.

Fully destroying Ezio ends the domination, but merely reducing Ezio to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.

Drink Blood.name: Drink Blood
Drink Blood.description:
Requirement A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within Ezio's reach.

Effect Ezio sinks its fangs into that creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions.

The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and Ezio regains HP equal to 10% of its maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to Ezio but increases the victim's drained value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5.

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:Blood Transfusion] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.

Turn to Mist.name: Turn to Mist
Turn to Mist.description:
Ezio turns into a cloud of vapor, as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG]{Vapor Form} spell, or back to its normal form. Ezio loses fast healing while in gaseous form.

Ezio can remain in this form indefinitely.

Sarcovalt.name: 腐鹫蝇 Sarcovalt
Sarcovalt.publicNotes:
单个腐鹫蝇几乎没有独立的自我，且记忆力极其短暂。

在多元宇宙中，很少有生物能比腐鹫蝇更加怪异和令人作呕，这是一种长着苍蝇身躯和无肉的秃鹫颅骨的魔族。尽管这种体长约为2尺的生物看似无法构成任何威胁，但腐鹫蝇集群能够吞没整个村庄。腐鹫蝇的头部与躯体仿佛是两个完全独立的实体，它们用喙捕捉吞食的任何东西都会在数小时后被呕吐出来，化为一滩腐烂凝结的淤泥。
Sarcovalt.allSaves: 对抗死亡效果时所有豁免+1点状态

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Death Effects.name: 对抗死亡效果时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Death Effects

Aura of Blight.name: 疫病灵光 Aura of Blight
Aura of Blight.description:
15尺。腐鹫蝇被致病瘴气所笼罩着。进入灵光或在灵光内结束自身回合的敌人必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:19]豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响，并且在1分钟内临时免疫灵光。

失败 直至其下个回合结束为止，该生物对抗疾病效果的豁免检定会承受-1点环境减值。

大失败 直至其下个回合结束为止，该生物对抗疾病效果的豁免检定会承受-2点环境减值并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 1}。

Befouled Body.name: 脏污之躯 Befouled Body
Befouled Body.description:
腐鹫蝇碰触的任何水都会沾染污秽热。

污秽热（疾病）

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:23|traits:disease]

潜伏期 [[/br 1d4 #days]]{1d4日}

阶段1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}（1日）

阶段2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}（1日）

阶段3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 2}（1日）

Reactive Detach.name: 反应分离 Reactive Detach
Reactive Detach.description:
触发 当有生物由于腐鹫蝇而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]，且腐鹫蝇将要受到另一个生物造成的挥砍伤害时

效果 腐鹫蝇使用分离头部。生物继续受到腐鹫蝇头部造成的受擒或束缚，腐鹫蝇身体快步。腐鹫蝇在对抗触发挥砍伤害时获得抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.78Dfh5ghvULGiyzk]{效果: 反应分离 Effect: Reactive Detach}

Return to Sender.name: 头部归位 Return to Sender
Return to Sender.description:
触发 当有生物从腐鹫蝇的分离头部造成的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]中逃脱时

效果 腐鹫蝇的头部通过最短的可行路径返回到身体上。处于其头部和身体之间的直线路径上的任何生物必须成功通过@Check[reflex|dc:21]豁免，否则会陷入持续1轮的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1}（大失败为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 2}）。腐鹫蝇解消分离头部。

Detach Head.name: 分离头部 Detach Head
Detach Head.description:
触发 腐鹫蝇由于挥砍武器造成的重击而承受伤害或者其头部被移除（比如通过斩首武器）

效果 腐鹫蝇在被斩首后仍能存活，而且原本能通过移除头部杀死对象的效果也无法杀死它。取而代之的是，腐鹫蝇的头部会从身体上分离开来。分离的头部与身体具有相同的数据（疫病灵光除外）而且会获得仆从特征。腐鹫蝇的身体能以单动作向它的分离头部发出语言命令，使头部获得2个动作。分离的头部和身体共享同一个生命值。

当其头部与身体分离时，腐鹫蝇的身体无法作出喙打击，也无法使用恶臭尖啸。分离的头部仅能攀爬、飞行、行走、作出喙打击或者使用恶臭尖啸。

Malodorous Shriek.name: 恶臭尖啸 Malodorous Shriek
Malodorous Shriek.description: 腐鹫蝇用其头颅发出尖啸（无论此时是否已经与身体分离），将头颅中残留的溃烂脏器喷向@Template[type:cone|distance:20]。区域内的每个生物会承受@Damage[3d6[sonic],3d6[poison]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]豁免）。腐鹫蝇在[[/br 1d4 #Recharge this ability]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用该能力。

Alceo Demetrias.name: Alceo Demetrias
Alceo Demetrias.blurb: Male aiuvarin human cleric of Milani

Defy Devils!.name: Defy Devils!
Defy Devils!.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet critically fails a saving throw or skill check against a devil, or a creature that worships devils or has a magical contract with a devil

Effect The triggering creature rerolls the check and must take the new result. It then becomes temporarily immune to Defy Devils! for 24 hours.

Divine Weapon of Milani.name: Divine Weapon of Milani
Divine Weapon of Milani.description:
Frequency once per turn

Trigger Alceo finishes Casting a Spell using one of his spell slots on his turn

Effect Milani blesses Alceo's morningstar. Until the end of his turn, his morningstar Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d4[spirit]] damage or @Damage[2d6[spirit]] damage if the target is unholy.

Sense Heartbond.name: Sense Heartbond
Sense Heartbond.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Alceo learns Phoebe's present state. He knows her direction and distance, and any conditions affecting her.

Ritual Backlash.name: Ritual Backlash
Ritual Backlash.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:20] or @Check[religion|dc:20] three times to suppress the backlash of energy, or defeat Viro Ahala
Ritual Backlash.hazarddescription: The space above the flame in the ivory bowl wavers and the smell of brimstone assaults the senses.
Ritual Backlash.routine: (3 actions) The hazard makes a ranged mindburn Strike, creates a Pulse of Fear, and bestows Vitality of Hell to Viro or one of his allies at random. If it's reduced to 2 actions, the hazard doesn't create a Pulse of Fear. If reduced to 1 action, the hazard only bestows Vitality of Hell.
Ritual Backlash.reset: Once Viro Ahala has been defeated, this trap can't be reset.

Pulse of Fear.name: Pulse of Fear
Pulse of Fear.description: Each of Viro's enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] from the ivory bowl must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:18] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

Vitality of Hell.name: Vitality of Hell
Vitality of Hell.description:
Viro or one of his allies gains 1d6 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.bwEZazVhE5KkLfwA]{Effect: Vitality of Hell}

Lash Out.name: Lash Out
Lash Out.description:
Trigger Viro Ahala rolls initiative

Effect Viro's lack of full attention unleashes the latent magical energy of the cave. The hazard creates a Pulse of Fear and then rolls initiative.

Godclaw Hellcrown.name: 神爪地狱亡冠 Godclaw Hellcrown
Godclaw Hellcrown.publicNotes:
无论在对抗任何地狱骑士团时，地狱亡冠都是人们众所周知的危害，当这些骑士来自神爪骑士团时尤为如此。这些地狱亡冠似乎能更加熟练地掌控维系其存在的死灵法术，而且有报告称它们能从幽灵躯壳中塑造出灵体武器，无论何时都能挥舞这些武器鞭笞敌人。这种地狱亡冠可能是人们能遭遇到的最危险的地狱亡冠。

那些精通与地狱骑士作战之道的人会告诫同伴：切勿斩下这些敌人的头颅。这是因为地狱骑士那超乎常理的忠诚心有时会将虚能注入到其头盔之中，从而产生名为地狱亡冠的躁动魂灵。地狱亡冠飘荡在空中，它们那宛如烟雾的幽灵身躯依稀呈现出生前曾穿戴盔甲的外观，尽管它们对生前事业的扭曲忠诚心尚在，但往昔的人性与自我意识却已所剩无几。

地狱亡冠不会加入到生者同袍的军队或兵团中，而是更愿意萦绕在自身殒命的那处染血沙场。地狱亡冠的力量强弱取决于死亡士兵生前的实力，以及它们对自身死因的恨意深度。在某些情况下，极为强大的地狱亡冠能施放法术，甚至形成幽灵集群，向它们认定的任何应为自身死亡负责的存在寻仇。

Agony Lash.name: 苦痛鞭笞 Agony Lash
Agony Lash.description: 由于神爪地狱亡冠的灵体鞭笞打击而承受伤害的生物必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:23]豁免。失败时，鞭笞的尖刺会嵌入到生物体内，造成@Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]]伤害，并且使得目标的速度在1分钟内承受-5尺状态减值。每次额外嵌入尖刺都会使得流血伤害增加1点并使得速度减值增加5尺。生物能以交互动作来移除一个尖刺，从而降低流血伤害和速度减值的数值。将最后的尖刺拔出能移除这两项状态。

Forbidding Stare.name: 畏惧凝视 Forbidding Stare
Forbidding Stare.description: 所有能看到地狱亡冠、并且受到苦痛鞭笞影响的生物必须尝试@Check[will|dc:25]豁免检定。豁免失败的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}，豁免大失败时该生物只要还处于惊惧状态就会同时陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]。无论豁免结果如何，该生物在豁免后都会临时免疫畏惧凝视，持续10分钟。

False Hellbreaker.name: False Hellbreaker
False Hellbreaker.publicNotes:
Guards are rank-and-file members of a town watch or city guard, trained to look for trouble, take down criminals, and follow orders.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

+1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed.name: +1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed objects

Block the Path.name: Block the Path
Block the Path.description: The false Hellbreaker prepares to harry anyone who tries to move past them. If it hits a creature with a Reactive Strike triggered by a move action, the triggering creature treats any squares within the steward's guard's reach as difficult terrain until the start of the false Hellbreaker's next turn.

Thin Ice.name: Thin Ice
Thin Ice.disable: @Check[nature|dc:31] or @Check[survival|dc:31] (expert) to spread out and prevent the ice from cracking further, or @Check[acrobatics|dc:31] or @Check[athletics|dc:31] (trained) to get off the ice safely as it cracks.
Thin Ice.hazarddescription: The white-and-blue ice is less structurally sound than it looks.
Thin Ice.reset: The river freezes over every night, restoring this hazard. The hazard disappears once the vernal equinox passes.

Crack.name: Crack
Crack.description:
Trigger Two or more creatures step onto the ice in area M8

Effect The ice beneath the party cracks. All creatures in area M8 must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:30] save. On a failure, they fall into the freezing water, whereupon they must succeed at a basic @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save against @Damage[(4d10+22)[cold]] damage. On a critical failure, the creature must start holding their breath or risk drowning as their muscles lock and they begin to sink. A creature must spend an action to Swim to the shore and must then succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:30] check to Climb up out of the water.

Breathless Thicket.name: Breathless Thicket
Breathless Thicket.disable: @Check[nature|dc:28] (expert) or @Check[survival|dc:28] (expert) to recognize the thicket for what it is and avoid it
Breathless Thicket.hazarddescription: A 10-foot-wide patch of dead shrubs with wilted flowers steals the breath of the living.
Breathless Thicket.routine: (3 actions) The breathless thickets patch attempts to Strike a creature in its reach. It then uses Suffocate if it has any creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}; otherwise, it continues to Strike.
Breathless Thicket.reset: The thicket goes back into hibernation 1 round after there are no more targets to Strike in its reach. It then remains dormant for 24 hours.
Breathless Thicket.stealthdetails: (expert; or –10 and no minimum proficiency if the thicket has been recognized)

Branch Ambush.name: Branch Ambush
Branch Ambush.description:
Trigger A creature that breathes steps within 5 feet of a thicket

Effect The thicket makes a sinewy leaves Strike against the triggering creature. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Branch Grab.name: Branch Grab
Branch Grab.description: If the breathless thicket hits a creature with its leaves, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the thicket. Unlike with a normal Grab, the creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move beyond the reach of the thicket's leaves. A creature can sever a branch by Striking against AC 18 and dealing at least @Damage[12[slashing]] damage. A branch doesn't have the thicket's Hardness, and damaging it doesn't deal damage to the thicket ([[/act escape dc=26]]).

Suffocate.name: Suffocate
Suffocate.description:
Requirements The breathless thicket has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} one or more creatures that breathe

Effect The dead flowers of the breathless thicket begin pulling oxygen from its victims' lungs. Each creature grabbed by the breathless thicket takes @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]|traits:nonlethal]{4d6 nonlethal bludgeoning} damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and can immediately attempt to [[/act escape dc=26]] as a free action.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is stupefied 1 for 1 round, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. For as long as it's grabbed by the thicket, the creature must hold its breath or suffocate.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and starts suffocating. If it's no longer grabbed, the creature stops suffocating.

Hecatinia.name: Hecatinia
Hecatinia.publicNotes:
Often leading a small team of lower-ranking guards, watch officers patrol their assigned areas to maintain order and enforce laws. Watch officers get the job done, though their methods aren't always gentle or kind.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

Air of Authority.name: Air of Authority
Air of Authority.description: 10 feet. Creatures in the aura who are the same or lower level than the watch officer take a -2 status penalty to their Will DC against the watch officer's attempts to [[/act coerce]] or [[/act demoralize]] them.

Bravery.name: Bravery
Bravery.description: When the watch officer rolls a success on a Will save against a fear effect, they get a critical success instead. In addition, any time they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition, reduce its value by 1.

Hunter's Fatigue.name: Hunter's Fatigue
Hunter's Fatigue.description: Having fought undead nonstop for the entire day, both Hellknights have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition. The condition goes away as usual with a full night's rest.

Sudden Charge.name: Sudden Charge
Sudden Charge.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The watch officer Strides twice. If they end their movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

Ravenous Pit.name: Ravenous Pit
Ravenous Pit.disable: @Check[nature|dc:23] or @Check[occultism|dc:23] (expert) three times to disperse the unusual energy surrounding the hole, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the engulfing magic
Ravenous Pit.hazarddescription: A seemingly ordinary hole in the forest floor exerts a strange gravity on creatures that come near.
Ravenous Pit.routine:
(2 actions) For each action, the pit chooses a different creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] to attempt to swallow. That creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save. On a failure, the creature is pulled 5 feet closer to the hole (10 feet on a critical failure). If this would pull the creature into the pit, that creature can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} as a reaction (DC 22). A creature who falls into the pit disappears into an extradimensional space that feels like being buried alive. A creature takes @Damage[(2d8+7)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] save) at the end of each its turns in the extradimensional space. A creature in this extradimensional space is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}; they can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} this extradimensional space with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:22], Nature, or Survival check. If they succeed, they appear in a random spot no more than 10 feet from the hole as if they had clawed their way from the dirt.

While this trap is active, all creatures treat movement away from the pit as difficult terrain.
Ravenous Pit.reset: If the trap isn't disabled, it becomes dormant for 10 minutes if there are no creatures within 20 feet of it at the start of its turn.

Deadly Inhale.name: Deadly Inhale
Deadly Inhale.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 15 feet of the hole

Effect The ravenous pit seems to "inhale," attempting to pull creatures into itself. Each creature within 15 feet must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save. On a failure, the creature is pulled 5 feet closer to the hole (10 feet on a critical failure). The pit then rolls initiative.

Littler Beasts.name: Littler Beasts
Littler Beasts.disable: @Check[nature|dc:20] or @Check[occultism|dc:20] twice to disperse the warped magic around the tree, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 19) to counteract the warped magic
Littler Beasts.hazarddescription: At first, the tree looks small. Then the space around it warps to give the impression that it's a normalsized tree seen at a distance.
Littler Beasts.routine: (1 action) The trap targets a random creature within 60 feet to try to bring it down to its size. That creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save. On a failure, the creature becomes Tiny in size until the beginning of its next turn. An affected creature's equipment shrinks with it but returns to its original size if removed. The creature's reach changes to 0 feet. This is a polymorph effect that has no effect on a Tiny creature. On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for the same duration.
Littler Beasts.reset: If the trap isn't disabled, it becomes dormant for 10 minutes if there are no creatures within 60 feet of it at the start of its turn.

Action.name: Action
Action.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 30 feet of the tree

Effect The tree seems to grow and shrink simultaneously. Each creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] saving throw. The trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of its next turn from the disorientation.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as if unsure of the distance between places.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}.

Gang Determination.name: Gang Determination
Gang Determination.description: When a Chelaxian loyalist is adjacent to at least one other ally, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.

Gang Determination.name: Gang Determination
Gang Determination.description: When a Chelaxian loyalist is adjacent to at least one other ally, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.

For Cheliax!.name: For Cheliax!
For Cheliax!.description: The Chelaxian loyalist leader Strides, shouting a Chelaxian slogan of loyalty. If they end the movement adjacent to a foe, they make a morningstar Strike against that foe. Each ally who hears and sees the loyalist leader attack can spend their reaction to Stride toward that foe.

+3 to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effects.name: +3 to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effects

Punishing Cut.name: Punishing Cut
Punishing Cut.description: Viro makes a longsword Strike. This counts as two attacks for his multiple attack penalty. If the Strike hits, it deals an additional die of weapon damage and 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

Shielded Charge.name: Shielded Charge
Shielded Charge.description:
Requirements Viro is wielding a shield

Effect Viro Raises his Shield and then Strides twice. If he ends his movement adjacent to a foe, that foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to Viro's Strikes until the end of Viro's current turn.

Creatures of the Night.name: Creatures of the Night
Creatures of the Night.disable: @Check[nature|dc:24] or @Check[religion|dc:24] (trained) to scatter the vermin; two successes are required to disable it
Creatures of the Night.hazarddescription: Bats and rats swarm around Ezio's enemies.
Creatures of the Night.routine: (1 action) The bats and rats bite all creatures in the room, doing @Damage[(2d8+3)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). On a failure, the creature also takes @Damage[3[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Infest.name: Infest
Infest.description:
Trigger Ezio summons the swarms

Effect The swarms coalesce in nauseating fashion. Each creature in the room must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The hazard then rolls initiative.

Prison Break.name: Prison Break
Prison Break.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:27] to stop the prisoners in their tracks, @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] to reason with the mob, or @Check[intimidation|dc:27] to cow them into calming down
Prison Break.hazarddescription: A prison mob makes a break for freedom, trampling anything in its path.
Prison Break.routine:
(1 action) Prisoners trample toward the exit, dealing @Damage[(2d10+9)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to each living creature in area K9 and the hallway north of it (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). On a critical failure, the creature's grasp on anything it's carrying is weakened as if the hazard succeeded on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} attempt. If its grasp was already weakened, they drop the item.

Special If the PCs have not defeated the hazard after 4 rounds, it automatically ends as all the prisoners escape.

Rush to Freedom.name: Rush to Freedom
Rush to Freedom.description:
Trigger The door to holding cell B opens

Effect The hazard grabs at the weapons of any creatures within 20 feet of the door, attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} them with a +19 modifier, and then rolls initiative.

Vampire Vulnerabilities.name: Vampire Vulnerabilities
Vampire Vulnerabilities.description:
